title: Binance Earn: Adjusting Multiple Dual Investment Trading Pairs
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Earn will be making the following adjustments on Dual Investment trading pairs to enhance user experience: From  2025-12-17 08:00 (UTC),  the following trading pairs will  no longer  be supported: BTC/FDUSD, ETH/FDUSD, BNB/FDUSD, SOL/FDUSD, LTC/FDUSD, NEAR/FDUSD, ADA/FDUSD, AVAX/FDUSD, BCH/FDUSD, SUI/FDUSD, DOGE/FDUSD, BNB/BTC, BNB/ETH, ETH/BTC, and all trading pairs of TRUMP, POL, NOT, DOGS, and S. From  2025-12-18 08:00 (UTC),  Binance Earn will add Aster (ASTER), Ethena (ENA), Zcash (ZEC), Uniswap (UNI), and Aave (AAVE) on Dual Investment. Please see the table below for more information, particularly on the additional APR rewards. Tokens to Be Supported after the Adjustment ASTER, ENA, ZEC, UNI, AAVE Token Pairs ASTER/USDC, ASTER/USDT, ENA/USDC, ENA/USDT, ZEC/USDC, ZEC/USDT, UNI/USDC, UNI/USDT, AAVE/USDC, AAVE/USDT Subscription Tokens ASTER, ENA, ZEC, UNI, AAVE, USDT, USDC Target Prices Multiple target prices available Settlement Date Every working day at 08:00 (UTC) APR 3.65% or higher Please Note: Products with delisted trading pairs that have not yet expired will be automatically settled on their settlement date. Starting from  2025-12-17 08:00 (UTC) , users will  no longer  be able to open new positions in Dual Investment for delisted trading pairs; Auto compounds related to delisted trading pairs will be automatically discontinued and will no longer continue after settlement at maturity. More Information: About Binance Dual Investment Binance Dual Investment Update: Earn Interest & Trade Smarter Top 6 Dual Investment Trading Strategies Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-12-17
